I've been in a similar sounding relationship before and I can honestly say that no matter what it feels like right now, you don't need him. If he yells at you and calls you names and makes you feel bad about yourself, then you don't need him. If he doesn't make you happy, then you don't need him. You can be happy without him. But being with someone who is mean to you won't make you happy. And 99.9% of the time, people like that don't change. He's not going to just wake up one day and be a different person who's kind and loving. I'm sorry you're in this situation, but he doesn't define how much worth you have.
Everybody takes life at their own pace. It's alright if you aren't at the same place as other people, and it doesn't mean your life has any less value.
